subject: note: Donne confesses that ‘a sickly inclination’ compelled him to ponder the question of suicide, and when this sickness befell him, ‘methinks I have the Keys of the Prison in mine own hand and no Remedy presents itself so soon to my Heart, as my sword’.
note: As paradoxical as it might sound, the decision to end one’s life is a requirement of life in order to escape a life of indignity and incarceration, the life of the concentration camp.
note: As Freud writes elsewhere, hate is older…
